verdict.rationale: Publishing bulk open data is a fair question for a government immigration service, so the axis applies. The evidence shows only an interactive processing-time checker and program and service pages. Nothing documents downloadable datasets, extracts or statistics files that would remove the need to scrape.

support.subject: As a developer, the service publishes bulk public-data downloads or extracts (datasets, registry extracts, wage or case statistics) that need no scraping
